```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(spDataLarge)
library(sf)
library(stars)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
```
# Part 1: `terra`

## 1. Load the data
```{r}
dem <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/dem.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
landsat <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/landsat.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
srtm <- terra::rast(system.file("raster/srtm.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
```

## 2. Explore elevation at Mt. Mongón, Perú

### 2.1 Make a boxplot and histogram of elevation at Mt. Mongón, Perú

```{r}
terra::boxplot(dem, main = 'Mt Mongon Elevation Model Distribution', ylab = 'Value', xlab = 'Elevation')
terra::hist(dem, main = 'Mt Mongon Elevation Model Distribution', xlab = 'Value', ylab = 'Frequency')
```

### 2.2 Reclassify dem and compute the mean for the three classes:

```{r}
reclass <- matrix(c(-Inf, 300, 0,
                    300, 500, 1,
                    500, Inf, 2),
                    byrow = TRUE, ncol = 3)

dem_reclass <- classify(dem, rcl = reclass)

levels(dem_reclass) <- data.frame(id = 0:2,
                              cats = c("low", "medium", "high"))

elevation_mean <- terra::zonal(
    dem, dem_reclass, fun = 'mean'
)
elevation_mean
```

```{r}
tm_shape(dem_reclass) +
    tm_raster(col.legend = tm_legend('Elevation class')) +
    tm_title(text = 'Elevation distribution of Mt. Mongon')
```

## 3. Explore NDVI and NDWI at Zion National Park

```{r}
# Defining functions
ndwi <- function(green, nir){
    (green - nir) / (green + nir)
}

ndvi <- function(nir, red){
    (nir - red) / (nir + red)
}
```

### 3.1 Calculate the Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at Zion National Park

```{r}
ndwi_rast <- lapp(landsat[[c(2,4)]], fun = ndvi)
```

### 3.2 Calculate the Normalized Difference Water Index (NDWI) at Zion National Park

```{r}
ndvi_rast <- lapp(landsat[[c(4,3)]], fun = ndvi)
```

### 3.3 Find a correlation between NDVI and NDWI at Zion National Park

```{r}
combine <- c(ndwi_rast, ndvi_rast)
plot(combine, main = c('NDwI','NDVI'))
```

## 4. Change resolution of elevation at Zion National Park

```{r}
rast_template <- rast(ext(srtm),res = 0.01)
srtm_clip <- srtm[rast_template]
```

# Part 2: `sf` + `stars`

## 1. Load the data

```{r}
dem <- stars::read_stars(system.file("raster/dem.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
landsat <- stars::read_stars(system.file("raster/landsat.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
srtm <- stars::read_stars(system.file("raster/srtm.tif", package = "spDataLarge"))
```

```{r}
class(srtm)   # should be "stars" in Part 2
```

```{r}
hist(dem,
    main = 'Elevation Mt Mongon',
    xlab = 'Elevation')
```

```{r}
boxplot(dem,
    main = 'Elevation Mt Mongon',
    xlab = 'Elevation')
```

```{r}
dem_rcl <- cut(dem,
        breaks = c(-Inf, 300, 500, Inf),
        labels = c('low','medium','high'))

plot(dem_rcl, main = 'Elevation distribution of Mt. Mongon')
```
